announcement.label: DEV / v0.2
announcement.title: DEV is moving fast while the full v0.2 source refresh is still being prepared.
announcement.text: Firefox DEV is already on the 0.1.9.x line, Chrome DEV is its separately published store build, and the Stable + DEV GitHub repositories are ready for their full root files. Features, changelogs and the website demo will read those root files automatically once they are uploaded.
